abstract: A case-control study to determine the gynecologic and reproductive risk factors for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia was conducted in the Baltimore Metropolitan Area. All cases (N = 190) that were pathologically diagnosed from 1975 to 1982 as hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, or choriocarcinoma were ascertained. Slides were independently reviewed by two pathologists. Cases were matched by age, race, and last menstrual period to controls who were delivered of normal pregnancies at term. In the analysis of medical record and interview data, factors found to be positively associated with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia included professional occupations (odds ratio = 2.56, p less than 0.0001), prior spontaneous abortions (odds ratio = 2.32, p = 0.02), and the mean number of months from the last pregnancy to the index pregnancy (cases = 35.9, controls = 28.2; p = 0.03). Factors found not to be associated with disease included contraceptive history, irradiation, ABO blood group, and smoking factors of the male partner. The findings suggest that gestational trophoblastic neoplasia may be part of a continuum of early (first-trimester) reproductive abnormalities.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）の婦人科的および生殖に関するリスク因子を明らかにするため、症例対照研究をボルチモア都市圏で実施した。1975年から1982年に病理学的に胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌と診断された全症例（190例）を抽出した。スライドは2名の病理医が独立に再検討した。症例は年齢、人種、最終月経日をもとに、正期産の正常妊娠を経た対照者と対応させた。診療記録と面接データの解析で、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と正の関連が認められた因子は、専門職の職業（オッズ比2.56、p<0.0001）、以前の自然流産（オッズ比2.32、p=0.02）、前回妊娠から今回の妊娠までの平均月数（症例35.9か月、対照28.2か月；p=0.03）であった。避妊歴、放射線照射、ABO血液型、男性パートナーの喫煙要因は関連が認められなかった。これらの所見は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が初期（妊娠初期）の生殖異常の連続体の一部である可能性を示唆している。
